basic_info.description: Marina District living at its best - this two-bedroom, two-bath condo is perfectly suited for comfortable, indoor-outdoor living and entertaining! Quietly located at the back of the building, This spacious, open floor plan has a gourmet kitchen with stainless steel appliances, Viking range, Bosch Dishwasher and a wine fridge.  The large, bright living/dining room has a gas fireplace and French doors that open out to a sunny, private patio.  The primary bedroom has an ensuite bathroom, custom closet and a private balcony, perfect for morning coffee.  The second bedroom shares the balcony. This lovely home has soaring 9 ft. ceilings, bamboo floors, in-unit laundry, and access to a large, sunny communal deck.  There is a large deeded parking spot and storage.  This great location is steps from the shops and cafes of Chestnut and Union Streets, Moscone Park, the Marina Green and Fort Mason.  Easy access to public transportation.
